title: Фронтирование и порядок слов для акцента

why: В русском порядок слов свободный: мы просто переставляем слово в начало для акцента. В английском порядок строгий, поэтому вынос слова вперёд (фронтирование) — особый приём. Он создаёт драматизм, делает текст литературным и расставляет акценты в докладах и статьях.
formation: • Место/направление в начале + глагол + подлежащее (инверсия без do): Into the room walked a man.
• Here / There + глагол + существительное: Here comes the bus. Но с местоимением порядок прямой: Here he comes.
• Дополнение вперёд, порядок остальных слов прямой: That I did not know.
• Прилагательное + as/though + подлежащее + глагол: Tired as I was, I finished.
• Such / So + прилагательное + глагол + подлежащее: Such was the noise that... / So loud was the music that...
• Only + обстоятельство + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее: Only then did I understand.
usage: 1. Яркая сцена: In the corner stood an old piano. (В углу стоял старый рояль.)
2. Привлечь внимание: Here comes the bus! (А вот и автобус!)
3. Противопоставление и акцент на дополнении: This colour I like, but that one I hate. (Этот цвет мне нравится, а тот ненавижу.)
4. Уступка: Strange as it may sound, I enjoy Mondays. (Как ни странно это звучит, я люблю понедельники.)
5. Сильная степень: So expensive was the hotel that we left. (Отель был настолько дорогим, что мы уехали.)
6. Ограничение со словом only: Only after the release did we see the bug. (Только после релиза мы увидели баг.)
signalWords: Here, there, away, down, out of, in the corner of; only then, only after, only when, not until; such, so + adjective; adjective + as.
mistakes: ✗ Here comes he! → ✓ Here he comes! (если подлежащее — местоимение, инверсии нет)
✗ Only then I understood. → ✓ Only then did I understand. (после only + обстоятельство нужен вспомогательный глагол перед подлежащим)
✗ Into the room did walk a man. → ✓ Into the room walked a man. (после места инверсия идёт сразу с основным глаголом, без do)
✗ Such the noise was that... → ✓ Such was the noise that... (глагол be выходит вперёд подлежащего)
✗ Tired though was she → ✓ Tired though she was (в обороте с as/though порядок прямой)
remember: Вперёд выносим то, что хотим выделить: место и only — с инверсией, дополнение и местоимение — без неё.

items.prompt: On the table ___ a letter for you. (lie, Past Simple)
items.answer: lay

items.prompt: Down the hill ___ the children. (run, Past Simple)
items.answer: ran

items.prompt: Only then ___ I realize the problem.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: Such ___ the noise that nobody could sleep.
items.answer: was

items.prompt: Tired ___ she was, she finished the report.
items.answer: as

items.prompt: In the corner of the room ___ an old piano. (stand, Past Simple)
items.answer: stood

items.prompt: Not until midnight ___ the team find the bug.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: Here he ___! (come)
items.answer: comes

items.prompt: (a) Here comes he! (b) Here he comes!
items.answer: (b) Here he comes!

items.prompt: (a) Away ran the dog. (b) Away did run the dog.
items.answer: (a) Away ran the dog.

items.prompt: (a) That I do not understand. (b) That do I not understand.
items.answer: (a) That I do not understand.

items.prompt: (a) Only after the release did we see the bug. (b) Only after the release we saw the bug.
items.answer: (a) Only after the release did we see the bug.

items.prompt: (a) Happy are the people who finish early. (b) Happy the people are who finish early.
items.answer: (a) Happy are the people who finish early.

items.prompt: (a) So tired was he that he fell asleep. (b) So tired he was that he fell asleep.
items.answer: (a) So tired was he that he fell asleep.

items.prompt: (a) Strange as it may sound, I like Mondays. (b) As strange it may sound, I like Mondays.
items.answer: (a) Strange as it may sound, I like Mondays.

items.prompt: (a) Hardly had we started when the power went off. (b) Hardly we had started when the power went off.
items.answer: (a) Hardly had we started when the power went off.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав с указанных слов

items.prompt: A big old tree stood in the middle of the garden. (Begin: In the middle of the garden)
items.answer: In the middle of the garden stood a big old tree.

items.prompt: I don't like this colour, but I like that one. (Begin: This colour)
items.answer: This colour I don't like, but that one I do. / This colour I don't like, but that one I like.

items.prompt: Although she was exhausted, she kept running. (Begin: Exhausted)
items.answer: Exhausted as she was, she kept running. / Exhausted though she was, she kept running.

items.prompt: The noise was so loud that we couldn't talk. (Begin: So loud)
items.answer: So loud was the noise that we couldn't talk.

items.prompt: We understood the problem only when the results came out. (Begin: Only when)
items.answer: Only when the results came out did we understand the problem.

items.prompt: A letter was on the desk. (Begin: On the desk)
items.answer: On the desk lay a letter. / On the desk was a letter.

items.prompt: The weather was such that we stayed at home. (Begin: Such)
items.answer: Such was the weather that we stayed at home.

items.prompt: The bus is coming. (Begin: Here)
items.answer: Here comes the bus.

items.prompt: Here comes he with the coffee.
items.answer: Here he comes with the coffee.

items.prompt: Only then I understood the joke.
items.answer: Only then did I understand the joke.

items.prompt: Into the room did walk a stranger.
items.answer: Into the room walked a stranger.

items.prompt: Such the noise was that we left.
items.answer: Such was the noise that we left.

items.prompt: Tired though was she, she kept working.
items.answer: Tired though she was, she kept working.

items.prompt: Not until I got home I noticed the message.
items.answer: Not until I got home did I notice the message.

items.prompt: This I did not know it.
items.answer: This I did not know.

items.prompt: So expensive was the hotel what we left.
items.answer: So expensive was the hotel that we left.

items.prompt: Вот идёт автобус.
items.answer: Here comes the bus.

items.prompt: В углу комнаты стоял старый стол.
items.answer: In the corner of the room stood an old desk.

items.prompt: Только тогда я понял свою ошибку.
items.answer: Only then did I understand my mistake. / Only then did I realize my mistake.

items.prompt: Хоть я и устал, я закончу отчёт.
items.answer: Tired as I am, I will finish the report. / Tired though I am, I will finish the report.

items.prompt: Шум был такой, что никто не мог спать.
items.answer: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.

items.prompt: Этого я не знал.
items.answer: That I did not know. / This I did not know.

items.prompt: Только после релиза мы заметили ошибку.
items.answer: Only after the release did we notice the bug. / Only after the release did we notice the error.

items.prompt: Из офиса он выбежал.
items.answer: Out of the office he ran.
